description: This file contains the implementation of the LayoutWorker class in the org.apache.ofbiz.content.layout package. The class provides functionality for handling image uploads via HTTP requests, extracting file data, and populating related parameters for further processing within the content management system.

classes.name: LayoutWorker
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for handling image upload requests and processing image data.

methods.name: uploadImageAndParameters
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to upload an image file, extracts the file data and form parameters, and returns a map containing image data, filename, MIME type, and other form inputs.

methods.name: returnByteBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the ByteBuffer containing image data from the provided map.
